Documented: index.md says VERIFY_TOKEN_INVALID also covers an invalid customer reset token; the 401-before-403 order is undocumented. Frontend workaround: Both reset codes map to customerPortal.errResetTokenInvalid; 401 → invalid credentials, 403 → not verified. (mxdashboard/src/modules/customer-portal/features/auth/hooks/customerAuthRejection.ts). Backend acceptance: index.md and /password-reset/complete name one code for an invalid customer reset token; /login documents that credentials are checked before verification. Live 2026-10-06: ✅ 2026-10-06 (v2-06 E2E runs): TC-FE-CUST-006 bogus reset token → 409; TC-FE-CUST-005 wrong password → 401. Backlog: newfront governance/project-artifacts/backend-backlog-erp-core-1.2.0.md#gap-sec-017

api_doc_gaps.detail: GAP-FILE-010 (CONTRACT_CHANGE, P1). Observed (erp-core 1.2.0): Unknown or unpublished slug → 404 FILE_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND (message calls the slug an "ID"; HEAD has no body); unknown tenant → 404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND; a 200 carries Cache-Control: max-age=86400, public, so a browser or proxy keeps answering 200 for up to a day after unpublish; every type is served Content-Disposition: inline (with nosniff and Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'). Documented: 403 cases and the response headers are undocumented. Frontend workaround: The viewer sends Cache-Control: no-cache (revalidates with the ETag) on every read; 404 → not found, 403 → unavailable, other → retry; inline rendering only for raster images and small plain text. (mxdashboard/src/modules/customer-portal/features/account/api/publicFileApi.ts, mxdashboard/src/modules/customer-portal/features/account/components/PublicFilePreview.tsx). Backend acceptance: The doc lists 404/403 and the headers; unpublishing is effective for caches (no-cache or a short max-age with must-revalidate); types not safe to render (HTML, SVG, PDF, …) are served Content-Disposition: attachment with nosniff kept. Live 2026-10-06: ✅ 2026-10-06 (v2-06 E2E runs): TC-FE-CUST-010 — HEAD 200 while published, revalidated HEAD 404 after unpublish. Backlog: newfront governance/project-artifacts/backend-backlog-erp-core-1.2.0.md#gap-file-010
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — backend work item GAP-FILE-010 (CONTRACT_CHANGE, P1); the frontend workaround stays until the backend answers

api_doc_gaps.sub: NOTIF:customer portal /customer/inbox and the CustomerShell unread badge (no page code)
api_doc_gaps.detail: GAP-NOTIF-006 (DOC_ONLY, P2). Observed (erp-core 1.2.0): Not observable live: no verified customer (GAP-SEC-013) and no documented flow delivers an IN_APP item to a customer. Documented: "Authorization: not extracted", no Business Responses (foreign or unknown id, unavailable channel), no unread-count endpoint, no list of the flows that deliver customer IN_APP items. Frontend workaround: Customer bearer only; 401 ends the customer session, any 403 shows "inbox unavailable", a 404 on mark-read toasts and re-reads; the badge reads totalElements of unreadOnly=true&size=1. (mxdashboard/src/modules/customer-portal/shared/api/customerInboxApi.ts, mxdashboard/src/modules/customer-portal/shared/hooks/useCustomerInboxQuery.ts, mxdashboard/src/modules/customer-portal/features/account/hooks/useCustomerInboxFacade.ts). Backend acceptance: The doc states the customer bearer/realm, the 403/404 Business Responses and which flows deliver customer IN_APP items (an unread-count endpoint is optional). Live 2026-10-06: not re-probed: needs a verified customer (GAP-SEC-013). Backlog: newfront governance/project-artifacts/backend-backlog-erp-core-1.2.0.md#gap-notif-006
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — backend work item GAP-NOTIF-006 (DOC_ONLY, P2); the frontend workaround stays until the backend answers
